==Description==
'''Petal Throw''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been obtained through the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]] regular track. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. You can move while performing this emote.

The emote causes the player to carry a basket with flowers in it. They will walk around with it and throw out colorful petals from it.

This emote was obtainable at Level 5 of the Spring Frenzy Battle Pass regular track, which cost {{Bunz|120}} or {{Robux|70}}. The total cost is {{Bunz|370}} or {{Robux|210}}.

==Update History==
*'''3 April 2026''' - [[v1.88.0]]
**'''Petal Throw''' added.
**{{Bug}} Using '''Petal Throw''' underwater will prevent the player from moving in a straight line.
*'''11 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0|v2.0.8a]]
**'''Petal Throw''' is no longer obtainable.
